query: I have a Node backend with a Stellar keypair. Swap 100 XLM to USDC through XOXNO's aggregator and tell me what the user actually gets.
expected_behavior: Fetch a quote without sender for the local builder. Use amountIn as base units and slippage as a fraction.

Renders amountOut, amountOutMin, priceImpact, rate, hops and feeBps from the response; explains that amountOutMin only exists when slippage was supplied and that the quote has no TTL, so it re-quotes after any change to amount, direction or slippage
Use the SDK route mapper with caller-owned expectations. Build locally, prepare, and check authorization against builtXdr before signing.
Polls getTransaction after send and treats PENDING/NOT_FOUND as still-in-flight rather than as failure; only FAILED is a failure

Reads the router address from configs/networks.json (`aggregator`) or STELLAR_NETWORKS[*].aggregatorRouter, uses /api/v1/config only as a cross-check, and links ../xoxno-lending/addresses.md instead of pasting a C... address into code
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js 1.0.228 and @stellar/stellar-sdk ^16
Imports come from '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar-lending' (grep finds no '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar' subpath import)
Quote request includes slippage; local builder flow omits sender and router query fields.
No string literal matching /^C[A-Z2-7]{55}$/ in the generated code
